description: Source code for Bluetooth Mesh SAR Configuration Server implementation in Zephyr OS, including model initialization, state storage, status message handling, and settings management.

methods.name: sar_rx_store
methods.description: Stores or deletes the SAR RX state in persistent storage.

methods.name: sar_tx_store
methods.description: Stores or deletes the SAR TX state in persistent storage.

methods.name: transmitter_status
methods.description: Sends the current SAR transmitter status message.

methods.name: receiver_status
methods.description: Sends the current SAR receiver status message.

methods.name: transmitter_get
methods.description: Handles GET request for SAR transmitter state.

methods.name: transmitter_set
methods.description: Handles SET request for SAR transmitter state and stores it.

methods.name: receiver_get
methods.description: Handles GET request for SAR receiver state.

methods.name: receiver_set
methods.description: Handles SET request for SAR receiver state and stores it.

methods.name: sar_cfg_srv_init
methods.description: Initializes the SAR Configuration Server model.

methods.name: sar_cfg_srv_settings_set
methods.description: Loads SAR states from persistent storage during settings load.
